definitions.title: Newton-Raphson Iteration Formula
definitions.statement: Newton's method approximates a real root of f(x) = 0 by replacing the curve with its tangent line at x_n and taking the x-intercept of the tangent line as the next estimate x_{n+1}.
definitions.explanation: Exhibits quadratic convergence near simple roots: the number of accurate decimal places roughly doubles with each iteration.
definitions.keyTakeaway: x_{n+1} is the x-intercept of the tangent line to f at x_n.
